program: Proposed expansion of integrated hepatitis C treatment
scope: One additional HCV-positive eligible enrollee offered integrated clinical access instead of facilitated referral; not generic navigation or all SFCHC services.
costPerspective: Gross additional clinical package cost, with no deduction for usual-care clinical costs or assumed reimbursement. Donor pharmacy share is zero under an unverified public/assistance-payment scenario; gross package DAA resources before funding displacement are reported separately. Not a complete societal incremental cost-effectiveness analysis.
nullBoundary: No additional confirmed cures, zero funding additionality, or immediate universal counterfactual cure produces no positive benefit. Reinfection and later cure are not known locally. Treatment or implementation harms can outweigh gains; the central model assumes no extra harm.
overlap: SFCHC already offers integrated care and has public support. Adding navigation inside that existing service cannot inherit the entire integrated-care-versus-referral effect. Deduplicate patients and shared health gains with SFAF, DOPE, HYA and medication-access programs; do not add independent lifetime gains to the same person without a joint model.

assumptions.label: Clinical cost per trial enrollee, 2020 USD
assumptions.basis: Kapadia microcosting: $6,035 excludes startup, physician downtime and DAA medication. Multiply by 84/82 to retain excluded participants' resources against the eligible efficacy denominator.

assumptions.label: Program startup, 2020 USD
assumptions.basis: Published $4,677; spread over an assumed 100 additional eligible people, not a verified expansion size.

assumptions.label: People sharing startup costs
assumptions.basis: 100-person hypothetical tranche; never equated with local contract targets.

assumptions.label: Full physician downtime per trial enrollee
assumptions.basis: Published $3,030; multiplied by scenario share and 84/82. Flexibility may require idle capacity; it is not automatically free.

assumptions.label: Downtime charged to this package
assumptions.basis: 0/50/100% judgment: integrated clinics may use some availability for other services. No local allocation verified.

assumptions.label: Local/current cost multiplier
assumptions.basis: 1/1.35/1.7 judgment, not an inflation series or SFCHC quote.

assumptions.label: Fraction of trial incremental access retained
assumptions.basis: Trial 55/82 minus 19/83 SVR12 difference. 100/50/20% judgment for otherwise referral-only people; could be zero inside existing integrated care.

assumptions.label: Share of expansion caused by gift
assumptions.basis: 90/50/25% judgment; current public service and replacement funding can make this zero.

assumptions.label: External lifetime QALY-per-cure anchor
assumptions.basis: MONARCH age-40 discounted bounds 2.3 (F0) to 6.4 (F4), algebra from 0.23–0.64 QALY per ten-percentage-point SVR improvement. Central 4 is a severity-mix judgment, not measured SF health.

assumptions.label: Effective health-benefit allocation window
assumptions.basis: 20-year heuristic, not a rerun of the lifetime Markov model. External total is allocated across this window only to stress-test timing and durability.

assumptions.label: Timing weight exponent
assumptions.basis: Annual weight year^shape: uniform / linearly later / quadratically later. Source does not provide this timing distribution; it is a major model judgment.

assumptions.label: Reference health discount rate
assumptions.basis: 3.5% matches MONARCH. Normalize the annual weights to the already-discounted anchor, avoiding a second discount of its total.

assumptions.label: Annual reinfection hazard approximation
assumptions.basis: Central .069 from 4 events/57.9 post-cure person-years in the external trial; 0.02/0.12 scenarios. Treating this short follow-up rate as a sustained hazard is speculative; no retreatment benefit included.

assumptions.label: Excess competing mortality hazard
assumptions.basis: 1/3/6% annually by judgment, additional to general mortality embedded in the reference model, not total mortality.

assumptions.label: Counterfactual eventual cure probability
assumptions.basis: 20/70/90% among people counted as additional one-year cures; judgment, not the trial control cure rate already subtracted.

assumptions.label: Years until counterfactual cure
assumptions.basis: 5/3/1-year judgment. No incremental health credit thereafter for that fraction. Does not model irreversible disease prevented before later cure.

assumptions.label: Resource cost per additional DAA start
assumptions.basis: $10K/$15K/$25K analyst assumptions, not current net Medi-Cal prices. Start difference 64/82 minus 22/83, scaled by access transfer; do not multiply by cure success again. This is a conservative gross-package resource sensitivity before funding displacement, not gift-attributable net resource use.

assumptions.label: Donor fraction of medication costs
assumptions.basis: Zero central conditional on public/assistance payment, unverified locally. Setting one charges full drug resources without changing health.

assumptions.label: Additional implementation harm
assumptions.basis: Zero central; explicit stress parameter for adverse effects and model omissions, not a measured harm estimate.
